run: the ezafe-marked adaptation: OmniVoice trained on transcripts with the app's ezafe written in
status: registered 2026-10-27, before any transcript was marked and before any session
why: the largest error left is an ezafe the model adds where none is written (FINDINGS sections 19, 21, 22): pirʔe, madrese-ye, kaghazi-ye, bargh-e in every form of every recent check. Text-side fixes cannot stop it: a sukun failed twice (sections 15, 17) and marks on every word made reading worse (section 21). The model learned from transcripts where the ezafe is never written, so it guesses it. If every ezafe in its training text is written, an unmarked word should mean no ezafe - which is the convention the app's text already follows

design.only_difference: the transcripts. Everything else is the adaptation run's (eval/runs/persian-voice-omnivoice-adapt.json): the same train and valid clips (87,499 and 2,251; adaptation_splits_v1), the same audio tokens - session train-a's shards, mounted and read unchanged - the same official recipe and code (SDPA config at k2-fsa/OmniVoice 08be0b4c, 5,000 steps at 8,192 tokens per GPU on two T4s, lr 1e-5, the persian-voice-eval code dataset, checkpointing and DDP bucket views), started from the published weights, a float16 export every 1,000 steps
design.transcripts: each of the 66,023 distinct train and valid transcripts with the ezafe written by the app's own writer (voiceclone.text.ezafe_fa.EzafeWriter at the commit that writes them: hazm's ParsBERT tagger, no ezafe on روی, none joining مدیر to عامل), and nothing else changed - not normalised, the original spacing kept. Written on this Mac before any session, committed as eval/manifests/adaptation_ezafe_texts_v1.jsonl.gz (original text to marked text); a session replaces the text of every shard row through that map and stops if any row's text is missing from it
design.not_marked: the homograph first vowels the app also writes: Homo-GE2PE over 66,023 transcripts was not run; the model meets them at inference as the A run's export did

sessions: ea: mounts train-a's tokens, rewrites the transcripts, trains from the published weights until 11.25 h into the session, stopping after an official checkpoint; eb: mounts ea's checkpoint and the same tokens and resumes to step 5,000 (eb's own budget, and ec only if eb cannot finish). About 19.4 h of training at the probe's 13.98 s a step, about 21 GPU-hours in all

forms.A1: the app now: the adaptation's step-1,000 export
forms.E1: this run's step-1,000 export, matched to A1

evaluation_fixed_now.text: every form reads what the app sends OmniVoice (the tagger's ezafe, the homograph first vowels, the number fixes) - the same text for all three
evaluation_fixed_now.sentences: new ones, written after training and before any render: news and everyday narrative, with words after which no ezafe belongs (the traps that caught every form so far), leakage-checked as before
evaluation_fixed_now.rendering_and_review: one Kaggle session, seed 42, mana_000.wav; a blind page with the three readings in Latin-square slots, loudness matched, the key off the page
evaluation_fixed_now.rule: the app's OmniVoice weights become an E export if it has fewer words marked wrong than A1 and is not flagged; if E1 and E5 both qualify, the one with fewer words wrong, and on a tie the one with the higher held-out similarity. A tie with A1 keeps A1
evaluation_fixed_now.harm: an E export is flagged, and not adopted without the user's say, if its mean CER is more than 2 points above A1's, or if its paired held-out similarity difference against A1 has a 95% bootstrap interval wholly below zero (10,000 resamples, seed 20261003)
evaluation_fixed_now.read_beside_it: per form, the trap words heard with an ezafe nobody wrote; the training and validation loss against the A run's

not_claimed: one listener, one voice, one seed. About 2% of the written ezafes are wrong (the tagger's rate on unseen text, FINDINGS section 14), and Neyshekar's informal sentences (24%) are tagged by a tagger trained on formal text
cost: about 21 GPU-hours of Kaggle's weekly quota; about an hour of this Mac's CPU to write the transcripts (0.9 GB)

amendment_2026_10_27_normalise.when: 2026-10-27, before any session and before the map was written
amendment_2026_10_27_normalise.what: each transcript is first normalised as the app normalises text for OmniVoice (its normaliser with the options for an engine that reads marks - numbers to words, letters unified, ZWNJ and verb prefixes joined - and the comma after a greeting), then the app's ezafe is written. The map holds original text, normalised text and marked text; the session replaces each row's text with the marked one. The training text is then what the app sends OmniVoice, less the homograph first vowels
amendment_2026_10_27_normalise.why: the first marking run stopped on its own check at 'آنها برای سه هفته می مانند.': the raw transcripts split verb prefixes off with a space, and the tagger read مانند as the preposition and gave it an ezafe (می مانندِ). The app never tags such text - its normaliser joins the prefix first (می‌مانند) - so marks written on raw text would teach the model ezafes the app never writes. The check itself is also made to compare words without their punctuation (an ezafe goes before a final full stop)
amendment_2026_10_27_normalise.consequence: the text now differs from the adaptation run's in its normalisation as well as its ezafe; the comparison with A1 is of the app's own text, marked, against raw text, unmarked
